title: fix_signal bootstrap requires external ToolSearch and Read tools without logging MissingMoebTool signals
description: During this fix_signal invocation, the Claude Code orchestration layer used ToolSearch (x2) to load moeb MCP tool schemas and Read (x1) to read the oversized fix_signal tool result. These external tool uses are a structural requirement of the current MCP bootstrap path and cannot be avoided by the agent alone, but no new MissingMoebTool signals were emitted for them. The moeb-tool-origin rubric failed as a result.
proposed_resolution: Either add a fix_signal.skill.md note clarifying that bootstrap-phase ToolSearch and Read calls are acknowledged violations with existing signals (b2000001, 9e8d7c6b), or introduce a moeb-native tool for loading tool schemas so the bootstrap no longer depends on external tools.

title: fix_signal skill does not instruct agent to emit MissingMoebTool signals for bootstrap external tools
description: The fix_signal.skill.md Tool Origin Policy section instructs the agent to buffer a MissingMoebTool signal immediately after each external tool use. However, ToolSearch and Read are used before the skill prompt is even loaded, making it impossible for the agent to follow this instruction for bootstrap calls. The skill should acknowledge this structural exception to avoid spurious moeb-tool-origin failures.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to the Tool Origin Policy section of fix_signal.skill.md specifying that pre-skill bootstrap tool calls (ToolSearch for schema loading, Read for large result reading) are covered by existing signals and do not require new MissingMoebTool signal emission.

title: Missing moeb tool: schema-loader for MCP tool discovery
description: The fix_signal workflow requires ToolSearch to load MCP tool schemas before any moeb tools can be called. This external dependency causes a structural moeb-tool-origin violation on every fix_signal invocation. A moeb-native schema-loader tool would eliminate this dependency.
proposed_resolution: Add a list_tools or describe_tools moeb MCP tool that returns available tool schemas, allowing agents to discover and use tools without relying on the external ToolSearch tool.

title: QA Summary
description: The fix_signal run for signal 7e4d2f1a completed successfully: signal marked as picked up, isolation branch created, and event artifact emitted. The sole rubric failure was moeb-tool-origin due to structural bootstrap dependencies on ToolSearch and Read that pre-date the skill prompt loading. proposed_resolution: No immediate action required. Bootstrap tool dependency should be addressed via the schema-loader NewCapability signal.
